issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: St. Paul Man Sentenced to 33 Months’ Imprisonment for Defrauding $1.6 Million in Federal Child Nutrition Program Funds as Part of the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
notes: Retrieved from the official USAO-MN host during the 2026-10-06 status sweep. This release explicitly states the current Feeding Our Future sentencing ordinal and therefore supersedes the prior 26th-defendant sentencing milestone for the headline sentenced-count metric.
supports: Abdi Nur Salah was sentenced to 33 months in prison on October 1, 2026 for his role in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme.
Salah is the 31st defendant sentenced in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme.
Salah was originally charged on September 13, 2022 and pleaded guilty on January 28, 2025.
does_not_support: A new charged-defendant ordinal or convicted-defendant ordinal; the release does not state either.
Any statewide fraud total or recovered-cash total.
